Package index

Verbs

Fit a learner, predict, evaluate, compare, tune, interpret and estimate contrasts from one formula and one dataset. Every learner, built in or your own, goes in model.

fit()
Fit a survival learner
predict(<survalis_fit>)
Predict from a fitted survival learner
evaluate()
Performance of a survival learner
compare()
Compare several survival learners on shared resampling folds
tune()
Tune a survival learner over a hyperparameter grid
interpret()
Interpret a fitted survival learner
estimate()
Standardised causal-style contrast for a binary treatment
as.data.frame(<survmat>) as.data.frame(<survalis_fit>) as.data.frame(<survalis_eval>) as.data.frame(<survalis_tune>) as.data.frame(<survalis_compare>) as.data.frame(<survalis_estimate>)
Tidy data frames from verb result objects
survalis survalis-package
survalis: Interpretable Survival Machine Learning

Resampling

Split schemes used by evaluate(), compare(), tune() and estimate().

cv() holdout() group_cv() bootstrap()
Resampling specifications for evaluate(), tune() and compare()

Scores

Decision-weighted scores over stated risk thresholds.

dwscore()
Decision-weighted scores for survival predictions
